request.initial_prompt: Lear. Where have I been? Where am I? Fair daylight? I am mightily abus'd. I should e'en die with pity, To see another thus. I know not what to say. I will not swear these are my hands: let's see; I feel this pin prick. Would I were assur'd Of my condition!
